summary: Source code is well-written with proper TypeScript types and error handling. Critical blockers: (1) Test files missing—workflow references tests/dateUtils.test.ts, evaluate.test.ts, config.test.ts, report.test.ts, format.test.ts, cli.test.ts (lines 55-61) but none provided; task requires TDD. (2) Fixture files missing—secrets-ok.json, secrets-warning.json, secrets-expired.json, secrets-mixed.json, secrets-invalid.json referenced but not provided. Repetition: Bun setup (checkout + setup-bun + install) repeated in 3 jobs—use composite action.
